title: Smart Markdown Editor
description: A cross-platform desktop Markdown editor with real-time HTML preview and an integrated Smart Assistant for document quality analysis. Provides readability scoring, heading-hierarchy validation, issue detection, and multi-format export (Markdown, HTML, DOCX, PDF, RTF, ODT, plain text) — entirely offline, with no cloud dependency. Designed for researchers, digital humanities scholars, and technical writers who author in plain-text environments.
